notes.title: Time Attack is here!
notes.notes:
The new mode, Time Attack, is now live!
2 minutes!
Extra time given from cracking cubes!
Work fast!
Shudder hard!
How high can your score go!
Try it now in this free update!
Two new achievements for Time Attack Mode and Survival Mode!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33317823/3cb1efddf680f9e472aa09b3d3e1d8d2573e44cf.png[/img]
